targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM monitors WHERE active
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM checks WHERE checked_at > now() - interval '1 minute'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM worker_heartbeats WHERE last_seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => offline_after_seconds)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM worker_leases WHERE lease_until < now()
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(checked_at,'1m'), region AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(checked_at,'1m'), percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_ms) AS value FROM checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT region,last_seen_at,last_result_at,offline_after_seconds,claims,results,CASE WHEN last_seen_at > now()-make_interval(secs => offline_after_seconds) THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS state FROM worker_heartbeats ORDER BY region
